title: Language-Conditioned World Modeling for Visual Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2603.26741v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Goal-conditioned visual navigation has been a long-standing testbed for embodied AI. We study a natural language-conditioned variant, language-conditioned visual navigation (LCVN), in which an embodied agent must follow a natural language instruction given only an initial egocentric observation. Without access to goal images, the agent must rely on language to shape its perception and continuous control. We introduce the LCVN Dataset, a benchmark of 39,016 trajectories and 117,048 human-verified instructions spanning diverse environments and instruction styles. Building on this benchmark, we study two complementary paradigms: (i) latent-imagination policy learning, in which a diffusion-based world model (LCVN-WM) imagines future observations and an actor-critic agent (LCVN-AC) learns its policy entirely within the imagined latent space; and (ii) unified autoregressive prediction, in which a single multimodal backbone (LCVN-Uni)

translated_title: 面向视觉导航的语言条件世界模型
translated_abstract: 目标条件视觉导航一直是具身智能领域长期以来的测试平台。我们研究了一种自然语言条件下的变体任务——语言条件视觉导航（LCVN），在该任务中，具身智能体在仅获得初始自我中心观测的情况下，必须遵循自然语言指令。由于无法获取目标图像，智能体必须依靠语言来塑造其感知和连续控制。我们提出了LCVN数据集，这是一个包含39,016条轨迹和117,048条经人工验证指令的基准数据集，涵盖多样化的环境和指令风格。基于该基准，我们研究了两种互补的范式：(i) 潜在想象策略学习，其中基于扩散模型的世界模型（LCVN-WM）想象未来观测，而演员-评论家智能体（LCVN-AC）完全在想象的潜在空间中学习其策略；(ii) 统一自回归预测，其中单一多模态主干网络（LCVN-Uni）
tldr: 该论文提出了语言条件视觉导航（LCVN）新任务及包含39,016条轨迹、117,048条人工验证指令的LCVN数据集，并通过基于扩散世界模型的潜在想象策略学习与统一多模态自回归预测两种范式，解决了智能体仅凭语言指令进行视觉导航的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Language-Conditioned Visual Navigation (LCVN) task and the LCVN Dataset of 39,016 trajectories with 117,048 human-verified instructions, addressing language-only visual navigation through two paradigms: latent-imagination policy learning with a diffusion-based world model and unified autoregressive prediction with a single multimodal backbone.
